Consolidated consent-procedure PDF; one-off legal basis showing NBRSM prior consent precedes CRM registration.
Banking Law PDF: static statute fixing governance terminology; evidence rather than monitored source.

Securities regulator publishing issuer-governance decisions; useful cross-check on MSE filings.

FOI platform listing CRM/NBRSM information officers; legal fallback channel for structured change lists.
Aggregator useful for entity/officer name resolution but partial, lagging and licence terms unclear.
One-off OGP commitment record documenting how CRM open-access will change; context, not a feed.
Canonical banking-association officer page naming bank executives; changes are direct leadership signals.
Mandate history ties association-office turnover to bank board departures; strong historical baseline.
Association structure/committee index yielding the member roster and commission chairs; mine once.
Highest-recall MBA announcements feed for assemblies, elections and appointments; failed check is soft.
Chamber association/group directory enumerating sector actors and elected chairs; one-time lead harvest.
Non-bank financial group page enumerating leasing, pension, insurance and card processors like Casys; on-scope for payments.
Chamber news feed reports constitutive sessions and officer elections ahead of static pages.
MASIT governance page naming ICT vendor executives serving banking clients; monitorable for board turnover.
Canonical ICT vendor member directory incl. KIBS and payments vendors; mine once as the population map.
MASIT news feed signals elections, new members and committee formation in the vendor ecosystem.
AmCham board page tracks senior finance-executive turnover across member companies.
